title: Garlic German Noodle Delight
description: A simple yet flavorful noodle dish made with garlic, onions, and a hint of German seasoning. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Mince the garlic and add it to the skillet. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the German seasoning blend and stir to combine.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss with the garlic and onion mixture.
Top with grated parmesan cheese and serve hot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
